title: AgentCoder: A Multi-Agent Framework for Code Generation with Effective Test Generation and Small Token Overhead

defines.name: AgentCoder
defines.definition: A three-agent multi-agent framework for code generation that separates programming, test design, and test execution to improve code quality with low token overhead.

problem: Existing code generation methods have weak feedback for refinement and often require too many agents, leading to high token overhead and less effective tests.
